chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Reza (peace be upon him), who said:
The dried bread digests the Citron.
ai.seo_question: What are the digestive benefits of dried bread according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* through the chain of Sahl ibn Ziyad, this concise hadith from Imam Al-Reza (AS) illustrates the practical application of *Tibb al-Nabawi* (Prophetic Medicine) by identifying dried bread as a digestive aid for the citron. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on empirical observation of food properties (*Mizaj*) and the integration of spiritual and physical well-being in daily life. It serves as a specific example of the broader Islamic principle of moderation and mindful consumption found in dietary jurisprudence.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Dry bread helps one to digests citron.’”
